contents.heading: Things you should know
paraGraph: Down Payment Planning Matters: A stronger down payment often improves eligibility and reduces borrowing requirements.
Pre-Approval Can Accelerate Buying Decisions: Borrowers with conditional approval are often better positioned when negotiating with sellers and developers.
Total Purchase Costs Go Beyond Property Price: Registration charges, stamp duty, legal fees, and insurance should be considered during planning.
Loan Eligibility Depends on Multiple Factors: Income, credit profile, employment stability, and existing liabilities influence approval outcomes.
